age.why: This is recorded during the admission, so we have it at the moment of discharge.

sex.why: This is recorded during the admission, so we have it at the moment of discharge.

deprivation_decile.description: Deprivation of the area the patient lives in (1 = most deprived, 10 = least).
deprivation_decile.why: This is recorded during the admission, so we have it at the moment of discharge.

long_term_conditions.description: Number of long-term conditions on the patient's record.
long_term_conditions.covers: the patient's record up to admission
long_term_conditions.why: This is recorded during the admission, so we have it at the moment of discharge.

emergency_admissions_prev_12m.description: Emergency admissions in the year before this one.
emergency_admissions_prev_12m.why: This is recorded during the admission, so we have it at the moment of discharge.

length_of_stay_days.description: Days in hospital for this admission.
length_of_stay_days.why: A stay isn't over until the patient leaves, so you couldn't know this at admission. But the model is run as the patient leaves, and by then we do have it. The moment the model is run decides what counts.

number_of_medications.description: Medicines the patient is discharged on.
number_of_medications.why: This is recorded during the admission, so we have it at the moment of discharge.

discharge_destination.description: Home, home with a care package, or care home.
discharge_destination.why: This is recorded during the admission, so we have it at the moment of discharge.

lives_alone.covers: the patient's circumstances during the admission
lives_alone.why: This is recorded during the admission, so we have it at the moment of discharge.

discharge_specialty.description: The specialty the patient was discharged from.
discharge_specialty.why: This is recorded during the admission, so we have it at the moment of discharge.

discharge_day.description: Day of the week of discharge.
discharge_day.why: This is recorded during the admission, so we have it at the moment of discharge.

gp_contacts_since_discharge.description: Number of contacts with the patient's GP practice.
gp_contacts_since_discharge.covers: the 30 days beginning on the day of discharge
gp_contacts_since_discharge.why: This counts GP contacts in the 30 days after the patient left hospital, so it doesn't exist at discharge. Patients who go on to be readmitted tend to have more of them.

outpatient_followup_attended.description: Whether the patient attended an outpatient follow-up appointment.
outpatient_followup_attended.covers: the follow-up appointment itself, which is a few weeks after discharge
outpatient_followup_attended.why: Whether a follow-up was attended can only be recorded once the appointment date has passed, which is after discharge.

community_nursing_visits_since_discharge.description: Number of community nursing visits to the patient.
community_nursing_visits_since_discharge.covers: the 30 days beginning on the day of discharge
community_nursing_visits_since_discharge.why: This counts visits made after the patient left hospital, so it can't be known at discharge. Readmitted patients tend to have had more.
